subject: Invoice handoff & ACK format questions
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@ace-supplies.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice submission questions for onboarding

Hi Irene,

Thanks for the intro — I’m Liam from Ace Supplies (we're getting set up as a new vendor). A couple quick questions on how you prefer invoices during onboarding:

- Do you want us to submit invoices via the vendor portal right away or is emailing billing acceptable while we wait for portal access?
- Is there a compact CSV template you prefer (we typically have single-line invoices per PO) — what headers do you need for reliable PO auto-match?
- Any filename convention we should follow to avoid manual processing?

We attached a quick sample of our usual export — sample_compact_invoice.csv — to illustrate our current layout.

Also, what is your timeline for acknowledging receipt vs first-pass validation (we sometimes need quick confirmations for urgent shipments)?

Appreciate the guidance.

Best,
Liam O'Connor
Operations Lead, Ace Supplies
[attachment: sample_compact_invoice.csv (csv)]
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@ace-supplies.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice submission questions for onboarding

Hi Liam — welcome, and thanks for the sample. Short answers below, followed by a couple of requests so AP can automate matching.

1) Portal vs email: Portal is our preferred long-term path (better auto-ack + PO matching). That said, email is an acceptable short-term fallback while your portal account is being provisioned. Please mark any emailed invoices with the subject "Invoice for Redwood - [PO#]" to help routing.

2) Required fields for auto-match: PO number (exact match), Invoice number, Invoice date (ISO YYYY-MM-DD), line-level amounts (or a total + service lines), currency, vendor legal name, and tax ID when relevant. If you send multi-line invoices, include a line-level PO reference column.

3) Filename convention (recommended): ACE_INV_<PO>_<INVOICE#>.<ext> (for example ACE_INV_12345_20260901.csv). That greatly reduces manual renames.

4) Acknowledgment SLAs: 
- Receipt ACK: within 2 business days of arrival (portal auto-ack immediate).
- First-pass validation (PO match / obvious errors): target 10 business days. If an invoice is urgent, please flag it in the email body and put "URGENT" in the subject so AP prioritizes.

Action items for you: please fill the vendor onboarding form here: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aBcD_onboarding_form (we need tax ID, remittance address, and preferred remittance method). Marissa — can you share the compact CSV header we prefer and the onboarding PDF for Liam to complete?

Thanks — I’ll loop back if any exceptions crop up during the first few submissions.

Cheers,
Irene Choi
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

- PO placement: we can include PO in a dedicated "PO_Number" column or prefix it to the invoice filename. Which would you prefer for better automation?
- Headers: our attached CSV shows columns: "InvoiceID,Date,PO,Amount,Tax,Description" — we can add VendorTaxID and Currency columns if that helps.

I've attached an expanded sample that includes a separate PO column. If you can confirm the required exact header strings, we'll adjust our export to match.

Also — does Redwood require remittance bank details on every invoice or only in the onboarding form?

Appreciate the turnaround; Liam

Hi Liam — looping in AP details and the vendor onboarding PDF (attached). Below is a compact checklist and the exact CSV header strings our ingest expects.

Quick checklist for your team:
- Complete and return the attached vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (we need tax ID, remittance address, and preferred remittance method).
- If emailing invoices: send to ap-invoices@redwood.com with subject line: "Invoice for Redwood - <PO#>" and attach CSV/PDF.
- If using portal: upload CSV with the filename convention Irene suggested.
- For urgent invoices: put URGENT in the subject and call AP.

Required CSV header strings (exact):
InvoiceNumber,InvoiceDate,PO_Number,LineNumber,LineDescription,LineAmount,InvoiceCurrency,VendorLegalName,VendorTaxID,BankAccountLast4

Notes on fields:
- InvoiceDate must be ISO (YYYY-MM-DD).
- PO_Number must match our PO exactly (no prefixes).
- If your system only exports a total row, include LineNumber 1 and LineAmount = total.
- BankAccountLast4 is optional but helps remittance match.

Filename convention: ACEINV_<PO>_<INVOICE#>.<ext> (example: ACEINV_12345_INV0023.csv)

Acknowledgement timelines:
- Portal uploads: auto-ack immediate; Email receipts: ACK within 2 business days.
- First-pass validation and PO-match: target 10 business days; if we find mismatches we'll email the contacts on file.

Attaching: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (please return signed) and a small CSV template ace_sample_template.csv for your export team.

If you want, we can do a 20-minute screen-share with Karthik to walk your billing team through the portal fields this week. When are you available?

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Accounts Payable Manager
Redwood Inference
